passive.name: Cannot Stop It!
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

passive.name: Fleet Triumph
passive.text: After the wearer uses attacks or gets hit, additionally regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy. This effect cannot be repeatedly triggered in a single turn.

passive.name: Heir
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **10/12/14/16/18%** and regenerates 1 Skill Point when the wearer uses their Ultimate on an ally. This effect can be triggered once after every 2 uses of the wearer's Ultimate. When the wearer uses their Skill, the next ally taking action (except the wearer) deals **30/35/40/45/50%** more DMG for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Departure
passive.text: After entering battle, if an ally deals the same DMG Type as the wearer, DMG dealt increases by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

substatLine: SPD > HP = DEF > Break Effect = EFF RES%

entries.name: Oracle Brush
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **100%** of Hanya's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Samsara, Locked
entries.text:
Deals Physical DMG equal to **240%** of Hanya's ATK to one designated enemy target, then applies "Burden" to them.
For every 2 Basic ATKs, Skills, or Ultimates allies use on an enemy with "Burden," allies will immediately recover 1 Skill Point. "Burden" is only active on the latest target it is applied to, and will be dispelled automatically after the Skill Point recovery effect has been triggered **2** times.

entries.name: Ten-Lords' Decree, All Shall Obey
entries.text: Increases the SPD of a target ally by **20%** of Hanya's SPD and increases the same target ally's ATK by **60%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Sanction
entries.text: When an ally uses a Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate on an enemy inflicted with Burden, the DMG dealt increases by **30%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Netherworld Judgment
entries.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, applies Burden equivalent to that applied by the Skill to a random enemy.

entries.name: Scrivener
entries.text: Allies triggering Burden's Skill Point recovery effect have their ATK increased by **10%** for **1** turn(s).

entries.name: Netherworld
entries.text: If the trigger count for the Burden's Skill Point recovery effect is **1** or lower when an enemy with Burden is defeated, then additionally recovers **1** Skill Point(s).

entries.name: Reanimated
entries.text: When Burden's Skill Point recovery effect is triggered, this character regenerates **2** Energy.

entries.name: One Heart
entries.text: When an ally target with Hanya's Ultimate effect defeats an enemy, Hanya's action advances by 15%. This effect can only be triggered 1 time(s) per turn.

entries.name: Two Views
entries.text: After using the Skill, this character's SPD increases by 20% for 1 turn(s).

entries.name: Three Temptations
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Four Truths
entries.text: The Ultimate's duration is additionally extended for 1 turn(s).

entries.name: Five Skandhas
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Six Reverences
entries.text: Increase the DMG Boost effect of the Talent by an additional 10%.
